turns.assessment: The common initiating event is the failure of the S18→S17 preamplifier oms.S18-S17.amp4. It raised AMP_FAIL at t=602.5 and then lost output power, coincident with widespread OCH LOS, receiver-power loss, and service/protection impacts. Its input power and upstream amplifiers did not change, strongly localizing the hard failure to this amplifier rather than the preceding fibre or an upstream source.

proposals.rationale: E16 is oms.S18-S17.amp4, which directly raised AMP_FAIL and lost output while its input and all preceding amplifier telemetry remained unchanged. A hard pump/unit failure explains the all-channel signal loss and simultaneous downstream OCH LOS affecting svc382 and the other services.
